title: The North Gate
description: A gatehouse of black stone squats over the only road into Gallowmere. The portcullis is raised, rusted in place, and an old gibbet creaks from the arch above it. Beyond the walls the moor road runs north into grey fog. Stone stairs climb to the wall walk, and the road runs south into town.

features.name: the gibbet
features.look: An iron cage hangs from a chain over the arch. Whoever was in it last has been gone a while. Mostly.

actions.touch: The cage swings at your touch and creaks loud enough to make the guard look up.
actions.take: It's chained to the arch, twenty feet up. Even if you could reach it, where would you put it?
actions.climb: You get a hand on the arch stones and think better of it. The guard is watching, and the cage is not quite empty enough.

features.name: the portcullis
features.look: Rust has welded the portcullis open. Nobody has closed this gate in years, and nobody seems keen to try.

actions.touch: Cold iron, rough with rust. It hasn't moved in years.
actions.push: You heave at the portcullis. It doesn't so much as rattle.
actions.climb: You climb a few bars, see nothing but fog in every direction, and climb back down.

title: Gate Road
description: Cart ruts have worn the cobbles into a muddy trough. Shuttered houses lean over the road as if listening. The watch barracks lie west, steps climb east toward the temple, and the market noise drifts up from the south.

features.name: the shuttered houses
features.look: Tall narrow houses with every shutter closed. One shutter twitches as you look, then goes still.

actions.push: You knock on a shutter. Inside, someone holds their breath until you leave.
actions.open: The shutters are barred from the inside. Of course they are.

title: Barracks Yard
description: A packed dirt yard where the town watch drills when it can be bothered. A notice board is papered with old bounties, most of them torn or rained into pulp. A stocks stands empty in one corner, its wood polished by unhappy necks. The watch house is north, Gate Road east.

features.name: the notice board
features.look: Old bounties, mostly rotted to pulp. One fresh notice reads: WANTED, the rat that ate the captain's boots. Reward negotiable.

actions.read: WANTED: the rat that ate the captain's boots. WANTED: whoever keeps writing on this board. NOTICE: the watch does not take bribes. Under that, in another hand: ask for Dace. And smaller still, a little drawing of a hook, and the words: above the fish.
actions.take: You tear the fresh notice down, feel the eyes of the empty barracks on your back, and pin it up again.

features.name: the stocks
features.look: A wooden stocks with holes for head and hands, polished smooth by the unlucky. Somebody has carved WORTH IT into the frame.

actions.sit: You settle into the stocks and rest your neck in the groove. It's oddly comfortable. That's the worrying part.
actions.touch: The wood is smooth as glass from all the necks.
actions.take: It's bolted to the yard. And heavy. And a stocks.

title: Temple Steps
description: Worn steps rise toward a squat temple of soot stained stone. Beggars have claimed the lower steps; the upper ones are kept clear by long habit and a short temper. Gate Road lies to the west.

features.name: the beggars
features.look: A row of beggars in grey rags, rattling cups at anyone who climbs past. They watch the temple doors more than they watch you.

actions.touch: The nearest beggar flinches away. "Coin, not hands," he says.
actions.search: Rummaging through beggars is a good way to get stabbed with a spoon. You leave it.
actions.take: Take a beggar? Nobody in this town comes that cheap.

title: The Temple of Ash
description: Cold air and the smell of old candles. Ash from a thousand offerings lies in drifts beneath a cracked altar, and a painted saint watches from the far wall with her eyes scratched out. Healing is sold here, they say, to those who can pay. The nave is east, the steps west.

features.name: the altar
features.look: A cracked stone altar heaped with grey ash. A brass bowl beside it is marked OFFERINGS, and it is chained down.

actions.touch: Ash coats your fingers. It's softer than it should be.
actions.search: You sift the ash. A tooth, two buttons and a copper so worn the face is gone. You leave them be. It feels like the right thing.
actions.take: The ash is the saint's, the bowl is chained, and the altar weighs as much as a horse.

features.name: the painted saint
features.look: A faded saint in a blue robe, her eyes scratched out long ago. Someone has painted a small smile back onto her mouth.

actions.touch: The paint is cold and a little tacky, as if someone touched up that smile recently.
actions.take: She's painted on the wall. She isn't going anywhere, and neither are her eyes.

title: Smithy Row
description: Heat rolls out of an open forge, and the hammer rings from dawn until well past sensible hours. Half finished blades hang from hooks along the wall. Hamo's shop floor is through a low door west. The market lies east.

features.name: the forge
features.look: A roaring forge, hot enough to make your eyes water from the doorway.

actions.touch: You reach toward the forge and the heat slaps your hand back. Good call.
actions.use: You give the bellows one pump. The fire roars. The blacksmith's look says do that again and lose the hand.

features.name: the half finished blades
features.look: Rough blades waiting for edges and hilts. None of them are for sale. Yet.

actions.take: You reach for a blade. The hammer stops. You put it back. The hammer starts again.
actions.touch: No edge on them yet. Give it a week.

title: Market West
description: Stalls of patched canvas crowd the west end of the market, selling rope, lamp oil and things that fell off other people's carts. A painted rat hangs over a low doorway to the south: The Drowned Rat. Old Tilly's curio shop is north, and Smithy Row lies west.

features.name: the stalls
features.look: Rope, lamp oil, bent nails, a single boot. Every stallholder swears their goods came by honestly.

actions.search: You poke through the stalls: rope, oil, a single boot. The stallholder watches you like you're the thief.
actions.take: The stallholder's hand lands on yours before you've lifted anything. "Coin first."

features.name: the painted rat sign
features.look: A wooden sign of a rat with its paws crossed over its chest, floating belly up. THE DROWNED RAT, it says, in case you missed the point.

actions.push: You swat the sign. It swings, and for a second the drowned rat seems to wink at you.
actions.take: You'd need a ladder, and a much better reason.

title: Market Square
description: The heart of Gallowmere, such as it is. A dry fountain holds a statue of some forgotten founder, his nose long since knocked off. Hawkers shout over each other, pickpockets work the crowd, and the town crier's platform stands empty for now. Stairs lead down to the market cellars, and roads lead in every direction.

features.name: the dry fountain
features.look: A dry fountain choked with rubbish. The founder's statue has lost its nose, and pigeons have claimed the rest.

actions.search: You dig through the rubbish in the bowl: a bent spoon, a letter too wet to read and one very surprised frog.
actions.climb: You clamber onto the founder's shoulders. The view is fog, roofs and more fog. A hawker applauds anyway.
actions.use: You try to drink from the fountain. It's dry, unless you count the rubbish.

features.name: the crier's platform
features.look: An empty wooden platform where the town crier shouts the news. A scrap of paper nailed to it says BACK SOON.

actions.climb: You climb onto the crier's platform. A few faces turn up, hoping for news. You have none. They turn away.
actions.read: BACK SOON, says the note. Someone has scratched a date under it. Three years ago.

title: Market East
description: Grocers and fishmongers hold the east end of the market, and the smell holds everyone else. Baskets of grey turnips sit beside eels that are still deciding whether to die. Maud's Provisions is east, the counting house south, and Butcher's Alley runs north. Market Square lies west.

features.name: the eels
features.look: A barrel of river eels, still twitching. The fishmonger insists that means they are fresh.

actions.take: You grab an eel. The eel disagrees, strongly, and wins.
actions.touch: Slimy, cold and very much alive.
actions.smell: Fresh, the fishmonger says. Your nose says otherwise.

title: The Drowned Rat
description: A low ceilinged tavern, warm and loud and sticky underfoot. Smoke hangs under the beams, dice rattle in a corner, and a long scarred bar runs the length of the room. A stained curtain hangs on the west wall, and nobody looks at it for long. A ladder climbs to the rooms upstairs, a trapdoor drops to the cellar, the back door opens east on the yard, and the front door north leads to the market.

features.name: the stained curtain
features.look: A heavy curtain, stained with things best left unnamed. A draught stirs it now and then, as if there were a room behind it.

open.text: You pull the curtain aside. Behind it, a cramped storeroom of barrels and sacks. You could slip through to the west.
open.room: pulls the stained curtain aside and peers behind it.
open.event: pulls your stained curtain aside and peers into your back room

take.text: You grab a fistful of curtain and give it a good yank. It holds. Every head in the tavern turns.
take.room: yanks hard on the stained curtain.
take.event: grabs your stained curtain and tries to yank it down

actions.touch: Heavy, stiff with old spills and smoke. A cold draught leaks through from the west.

features.name: the dice game
features.look: A knot of drinkers hunched over a battered cup of dice. They stop talking when you get close.

use.text: You lean in to join the game. The players close ranks without looking up. Locals only, apparently.
use.room: tries to join the dice game and gets frozen out.

take.text: You scoop up the dice. Every player at the table goes very still. You put them back.
take.room: scoops up the dice from the game, then puts them back.
take.event: snatches the dice off your regulars' table, then puts them back

title: The Back Room
description: Behind the curtain, a cramped storeroom of barrels and sacks. One barrel is not like the others: it has a ledger tucked behind it, wrapped in oilcloth. The tavern lies east.

features.name: the oilcloth ledger
features.look: A ledger wrapped in oilcloth, full of neat columns of debts. Most of the pages are signed with a small drawing of a hook.

actions.read: Columns of debts, all owed to someone who signs with a small hook. The biggest line on the last page is in a heavy hand: The Drowned Rat, everything.
actions.take: You tuck the ledger under your arm, think about Morda, the docks and that little hook, and put it back exactly where it was.

features.name: the barrels
features.look: Ale barrels, flour sacks and a crate marked TURNIPS that is suspiciously heavy.

actions.search: Ale, flour and a crate marked TURNIPS full of something wrapped in sacking that is definitely not turnips. You decide you never saw it.
actions.open: You lever the lid off the turnip crate. Not turnips. You put the lid back very carefully.
actions.use: You put your mouth under an ale tap. Warm, flat, and still better than the river.

title: Wet Lane
description: A narrow lane that is never dry, sloping down toward the river. Water drips from every gutter and collects in black puddles. Somebody is always sleeping in a doorway here. The market is north, the docks south.

features.name: the black puddles
features.look: Puddles of black water that never dry. Something glints at the bottom of one, then it is gone.

actions.search: You reach into the black water. Your fingers close on something small and round, then it slips away. A coin. Probably.
actions.touch: Colder than it should be.

title: Docks Stair
description: Slick stone stairs drop to the riverside. The river is wide and brown and in no hurry. East, boats knock against the docks; west, a rusted grate breathes foul air out of the town wall.

features.name: the river
features.look: Wide, brown and slow. Things float by now and then, and it is best not to look too closely at them.

actions.touch: Cold, brown and slow. Something brushes your fingers and you pull back fast.
actions.use: You cup your hands, look at the water, and think better of drinking it. Wise.

title: River Docks
description: Rotting piers and fishing boats with names painted over other names. Crates are stacked high and watched closely by men who say they are not watching anything. The fish market is east, a beached hulk lies south on the mud, and the stair climbs west.

features.name: the stacked crates
features.look: Crates stamped with the marks of a dozen ports, several of them crossed out. A man nearby suddenly finds the sky very interesting.

actions.open: You get a fingernail under a lid. A man appears at your elbow. "Wrong crate, friend." You agree that it is.
actions.read: Port stamps from everywhere, half of them crossed out. One crate says FRAGILE in three languages and has been dropped in all of them.
actions.take: Too heavy to lift alone, and far too watched to try with help.

features.name: the harbourmaster's shed
features.look: A tarred wooden shed, locked tight. A sign on the door says CLOSED in large letters and BRIBES TUESDAYS in small ones.

actions.open: Locked. Bribes are Tuesdays, says the sign. Today is not Tuesday.
actions.push: You knock. Something heavy shifts inside, then goes very quiet.

title: The Sewer Grate
description: A great iron grate set into the base of the wall, where the town empties itself into the river. The bars are bent wide enough for a thin person, or a large rat. You could squeeze down through them. Something down there is scratching. The stair lies east.

features.name: the iron grate
features.look: Thick iron bars, bent apart by something strong or someone stubborn. A foul warm breath rises from the dark beyond.

actions.touch: Slimy bars, bent wide enough for someone thin. The air coming through is warm and foul.
actions.climb: You get a shoulder between the bars. It's a squeeze, but you'd fit. Go down if you've the stomach for it.

title: The Moor Road
description: The road north runs out of town and straight into the fog. A few yards on, a cart lies on its side with one wheel still turning in the wind. Past it the ruts vanish into wet heather. Whatever is out there, farms or worse, the road is not ready to take you yet. The gate lies south.

features.name: the overturned cart
features.look: A farm cart on its side, its load of turnips scattered and half eaten by something with small teeth. The wheel still turns, slowly, though there's no wind you can feel.

actions.search: You go through the spilled load. Turnips, a broken harness and a muddy boot print far too big for a horse. You leave the rest to the fog.
actions.push: You heave at the cart. It rocks, settles back and the wheel keeps turning.

features.name: the fog
features.look: Thick, grey and patient. Somewhere inside it a dog barks twice and stops.

actions.touch: Cold and wet. It clings to your fingers like it wants to come back into town with you.
actions.climb: You take a few steps into the fog and lose sight of the gate at once. You turn back while you still can.

title: The Wall Walk
description: A narrow stone walk along the top of the town wall, slick with moss and gull droppings. From up here Gallowmere is a huddle of wet roofs and chimney smoke, the river a brown curve beyond. North, the moor road disappears into fog. Stairs lead down to the gate.

features.name: the view
features.look: Smoke from a hundred chimneys, the temple bell tower, the masts at the docks. From up here it almost looks like a place someone would choose to live.

actions.search: You pick out the market, the temple, the Rat. Down by the river a figure ducks into the net loft and doesn't come out.
actions.use: You take in the view. It doesn't take you in back.

features.name: the crenels
features.look: Gaps in the parapet, worn smooth by centuries of bored watchmen leaning on them.

actions.touch: Cold, damp stone. Someone has carved a tally of days into one merlon. They stopped at forty one.
actions.sit: You sit in a crenel with your legs over the drop. The wind tries to talk you into something stupid.

title: The Watch House
description: A low guardroom that smells of wet wool and cheap tallow. Spears lean in a rack, most of them rusty. A table is covered in dice, crusts and a duty roster nobody has updated in weeks. Stairs climb to the captain's office and a heavy door leads down to the lockup. The yard is south.

features.name: the spear rack
features.look: A dozen spears, half of them rusted to the rack. One has a sausage tied to the end.

actions.take: You lift a spear out of the rack. Nobody stops you, which is somehow worse. You put it back.
actions.touch: Rust comes off on your hand. These haven't seen a fight in years.

features.name: the duty roster
features.look: A slate with names chalked on it. Dace's name is on every gate shift. Someone has added: NOT AGAIN.

actions.read: NORTH GATE: Dace. NORTH GATE: Dace. NORTH GATE: Dace. Under it, smudged: ask Dace why he likes it so much.
actions.take: It's a slate nailed to the wall. You'd need the wall.

title: The Captain's Office
description: A cramped room with a desk too big for it and a window too small. The captain is never here. The chair is pushed back, the ink is dry, and a bottle sits half finished on a stack of unsigned warrants. The stairs lead down.

features.name: the warrants
features.look: Arrest warrants, months old, all unsigned. Several are for people who are clearly still drinking at the Rat.

actions.read: Theft of eels. Theft of more eels. Assault on a stallholder. Fencing stolen goods, name left blank, with a little hook drawn in the margin.
actions.take: You think about walking out with the town's justice under your arm. You put it back. Nobody would notice either way.

features.name: the bottle
features.look: Cheap brandy, half gone, with a ring of dust around the base. It has been half gone for a long time.

actions.use: You take a pull. It burns all the way down and makes your eyes water. You understand the captain a little better.
actions.smell: Turpentine, mostly. With notes of regret.

title: The Lockup
description: Three iron cages in a cellar that floods at high tide. Two are empty. The third holds a pile of straw that might be a prisoner or might just be straw. Water drips somewhere in the dark. Stairs lead up.

features.name: the cages
features.look: Iron bars thick as your thumb, rusted at the joints. The doors hang open. The town can't afford a jailer.

actions.open: The nearest cage door swings with a shriek that echoes up the stairs. Somewhere above, nobody comes to check.
actions.touch: Cold and rough. Someone has scratched a calendar into the wall behind one of them.

features.name: the straw
features.look: Damp, filthy straw. It moves, just slightly, when you aren't looking straight at it.

actions.search: You poke the straw. It snores. You stop poking the straw.
actions.kick: You nudge it with a boot. A hand comes out, takes nothing, and goes back in.

title: The Nave
description: Rows of benches face a pulpit where Father Osmund preaches to whoever is too drunk or too cold to leave. Candles gutter in iron stands and the walls are black with old smoke. A door north leads to the healer's ward, stairs drop to the ossuary, and a ladder climbs into the bell tower. The altar room is west.

features.name: the benches
features.look: Old wooden benches, worn smooth. Someone has carved their initials into every one, along with some opinions about the sermons.

actions.sit: You sit on a bench. It creaks. The silence of the place settles on your shoulders like a wet coat.
actions.read: Initials, hearts, a crude drawing of the priest, and in tiny careful letters: HE DOESN'T BELIEVE IT EITHER.

features.name: the candles
features.look: Tallow candles, cheap and smoky, in iron stands. A tin box beside them is marked ONE COPPER EACH.

actions.take: You reach for a candle. The tin box rattles meaningfully. Father Osmund sells them, if you want one.
actions.use: You light a candle from another. For a moment the nave is a little warmer. Then a draught takes it.

title: The Healer's Ward
description: Six cots, clean sheets, and a smell of vinegar and boiled linen. It is the only clean room in Gallowmere and the most expensive one. A shelf of bottles and bandages stands behind a locked grille. The nave is south.

features.name: the cots
features.look: Narrow beds with clean sheets. One has a name scratched into the frame and a date. Under it someone has written SURVIVED.

actions.sit: You sit on the edge of a cot. It's the softest thing you've touched since you came out of the fog. You don't trust it.
actions.search: Under one cot: a single tooth and a copper coin. You leave both. This feels like a place that keeps count.

features.name: the locked grille
features.look: Bottles of tinctures, rolls of bandage, jars with handwritten labels. Locked behind iron. Father Osmund has the only key.

actions.open: Locked. The keyhole is clean and well oiled. Someone opens this often.
actions.read: The labels say: Poppy. Willow. Vinegar. Mercy, 20 coin.

title: The Ossuary
description: A low vault under the temple, stacked floor to ceiling with bones. Skulls line the walls in neat rows, each with a name painted on the brow, though most have faded. It is very quiet down here. Stairs lead up.

features.name: the skulls
features.look: Rows of skulls, each painted with a name. Some are recent. One brow is still blank, freshly scrubbed, as if waiting.

actions.read: Agnes. Wat. Old Dodd. A Stranger, Found in the Fog. A Stranger, Found in the Fog. A Stranger, Found in the Fog.
actions.take: You lift a skull. Its painted name is your own. You blink, and it isn't. You put it back very carefully.

features.name: the bone stacks
features.look: Thigh bones stacked like firewood. They've been here a long time and they're in no hurry.

actions.search: You go through the stacks and find nothing but more bones and a feeling of being watched by all of them.
actions.touch: Dry and light. You wipe your hand on your coat and keep wiping it for a while.

title: The Bell Tower
description: A ladder climbs into a draughty wooden tower where a cracked bronze bell hangs from a blackened beam. Pigeons scatter. Through the louvres the whole town lies below, and past the wall, the endless fog. The ladder leads down.

features.name: the bell
features.look: A big bronze bell with a crack running from lip to crown. It hasn't rung true in years.

use.text: You haul on the rope. The bell gives a cracked, flat clang that rolls across every roof in town. Every dog in Gallowmere starts barking.
use.room: rings the cracked bell. The whole town hears it.

actions.push: You shove the bell. It swings a little and hums, low and sour, for a long time after.
actions.touch: Cold bronze. The crack is wide enough to slip a coin into. Several people have.

features.name: the louvres
features.look: Wooden slats open to the wind. Below: the market, the docks, the river. Above: rain, mostly.

actions.search: You look out over the town. A figure on the docks climbs to the net loft and pulls the ladder up after them.
actions.climb: You lean out through the louvres. The drop to the cobbles is long enough to think about on the way down. You lean back in.

title: Maud's Provisions
description: A narrow shop crammed floor to rafters with sacks, barrels, coils of rope and strings of onions. Everything is priced in chalk and the chalk is smudged in Maud's favour. A counter of scarred oak stands between you and the goods. Market East is west.

features.name: the price board
features.look: A slate of prices in Maud's square hand. Several numbers have been rubbed out and written again, higher.

actions.read: Bread 2. Turnips 2. Rope 6. Lamp 9. Oil 3. Candle 2. Sack 2. Below, underlined twice: NO CREDIT. NO HAGGLING. (The second rule is clearly negotiable.)
actions.take: It's nailed to the wall. Maud would nail you next to it.

features.name: the sacks
features.look: Flour, oats, dried peas, salt. Everything here has a smell and they're all fighting.

actions.search: You poke through the sacks. Maud's voice comes from behind the counter: "Buy it or leave it be."
actions.take: Maud's hand is on the counter, palm up, before you've even lifted it. Ask her for a list.

title: Butcher's Alley
description: A slick, narrow alley behind Market East where the butcher hangs his meat and the flies hang around it. The cobbles run red after rain and sometimes before it. A chopping block stands under an awning. Market East is south.

features.name: the chopping block
features.look: A thick stump scored with a thousand cuts. A cleaver is buried in it, handle up.

actions.take: You grip the cleaver and pull. It doesn't come out. The butcher, somewhere, laughs.
actions.touch: Sticky. You decide not to think about it.

features.name: the hanging meat
features.look: Sides of mutton and something that might have been a goat swing from iron hooks. The flies have opinions.

actions.smell: Blood, sawdust and old fat. Your stomach turns over and then, traitorously, rumbles.
actions.take: You reach for a joint. A dog under the awning growls in a voice much too deep for its size.

title: The Counting House
description: A cold stone room with one window, barred, and one counter, also barred. Behind the bars Ingelram the clerk sits among ledgers and scales, weighing coin with the care other men give their children. Coin deposited here is safe from the plague cart, they say. Market East is north.

features.name: the scales
features.look: Brass scales, polished bright. Ingelram weighs every coin twice and trusts neither result.

actions.touch: Ingelram's quill raps your knuckles through the bars before you get close.
actions.use: Ingelram weighs a coin, frowns, weighs it again and drops it in a box marked LIGHT.

features.name: the ledgers
features.look: Thick ledgers bound in black leather, every page ruled and every column added twice.

actions.read: Columns of names and figures. Yours is in there now, small and unimportant.
actions.take: The bars are in the way. So is Ingelram, who has stopped writing to watch you.

title: Tilly's Curios
description: A dark little pawnshop off Market West, every shelf heaped with the things people sold when they ran out of better ideas: wedding rings, false teeth, a stuffed heron, a single good boot. Old Tilly sits in the middle of it all like a spider. Market West is south.

features.name: the heaped shelves
features.look: Rings, buckles, spoons, a glass eye, a lute with two strings. Each has a paper tag and a story nobody wants told.

actions.search: You turn over the junk. A locket opens to show a tiny painted face that has been scratched out. You close it.
actions.take: Tilly coughs once. It's the cough of a woman who has been robbed before and remembers every face.

features.name: the stuffed heron
features.look: A heron, stuffed badly, one glass eye looking at you and the other at the door.

actions.touch: Dusty feathers and a smell of camphor. One wing falls off. You prop it back up and hope Tilly didn't see.
actions.take: "Not for sale," says Tilly. "That's Gerald."

title: Hamo's Shop Floor
description: Behind the forge, a low room of racks and hooks where finished work waits for buyers. Knives, hinges, horseshoes, nails by the bucket. A rack at the back holds blades under a tarp. It's hot even here, and everything smells of iron. Smithy Row is east.

features.name: the tarp
features.look: Under the tarp: swords, cudgels and axe heads, sharp and unbloodied. A tag on the rack says NOT YET.

actions.open: You lift the tarp. Steel glints. A heavy hand drops it back down. "Not yet," says Hamo, from the forge.
actions.take: Your hand barely touches the tarp before the hammer next door goes quiet. You step back. It starts again.

features.name: the nail buckets
features.look: Buckets of nails sorted by size. Someone has sorted them very carefully and then kicked one over.

actions.search: You sift through the nails and come up with a splinter of iron in your thumb and nothing else.
actions.kick: You kick a bucket. Nails everywhere. From the forge, a long, slow sigh.

title: The Market Cellars
description: A warren of brick vaults under Market Square where the stallholders keep their stock and the rats keep the stallholders honest. Lanterns are few. Things get lost down here and some of them get found. Stairs lead up to the square.

features.name: the discarded crates
features.look: Broken crates and rotten sacking, the leftovers of a hundred market days. People throw away all kinds of things.

actions.kick: You kick a crate apart. Rats boil out of it in every direction and you regret everything.
actions.take: Rotten wood and wet sacking. Nothing here is worth carrying except what's buried in it. Try searching.

features.name: the dark corners
features.look: The vaults go back further than the lantern light. Something drips. Something else scuttles.

actions.listen: Water. Rats. And under them, far off, a slow knocking like someone patient behind a door.
actions.climb: You feel along the wall into the dark and find a bricked up arch. Fresh mortar. Interesting.

title: Rooms Above the Rat
description: A creaking landing over the tavern with four doors, three locked. Through the floorboards comes the noise of the bar, and through the walls comes the noise of guests who paid for the night. A ladder leads down.

features.name: the doors
features.look: Four doors with brass numbers. Three are locked. The fourth is ajar and smells of someone else's feet.

actions.open: The open door shows a bed, a pot and a window that doesn't close. Morda rents these by the night, if you ask her.
actions.push: You knock on a locked door. It goes very quiet inside. Then someone very carefully shoots the bolt.

features.name: the floorboards
features.look: Gaps wide enough to see the bar below. Also to hear it.

actions.search: Through the gap you watch Morda slip something under the bar when she thinks nobody's looking.
actions.listen: Below you, Morda: "...not until Tuesday, and tell Hook I said so."

title: The Dice Cellar
description: Under the Rat, a low beer cellar where the serious games happen. A plank table stands between the barrels with a candle stuck to it. The stakes here are higher and the players don't smile. A ladder leads up.

features.name: the plank table
features.look: Scarred, wax spattered, with a cup of dice and a pile of coin. The players watch your hands, not your face.

actions.use: You reach for the dice cup. A knife lands point first in the plank next to your fingers. "Coin on the table first," says a voice. You don't have the nerve. Yet.
actions.search: Under the table: a loaded die, weighted toward six. Somebody here is a cheat. Everybody here is a cheat.

features.name: the beer barrels
features.look: Barrels of Morda's ale, chalked with dates. Some of the dates are very old.

actions.use: You sneak a mug from a tap. It tastes better down here. That's probably the thrill.
actions.kick: The barrel booms. Upstairs, Morda bangs on the floor.

title: The Rat's Yard
description: A muddy yard behind the tavern, walled in, with a privy, a woodpile and a midden heap that steams in the cold. Empty casks are stacked against the wall. The back door to the tavern is west.

features.name: the midden heap
features.look: Kitchen scraps, broken crockery, ash and worse. It steams. Things are buried in it that people meant to stay buried.

search.text: Holding your breath, you dig through the midden.

actions.smell: It smells exactly like you'd think. Then a little worse.

features.name: the empty casks
features.look: Empty ale casks waiting for the cooper. One has a chalk mark: HOOK, TUESDAY.

actions.read: HOOK, TUESDAY. Then a tally of marks, and a sum that makes your eyes water.
actions.kick: Hollow boom. A cat shoots out of one and over the wall.

title: The Fish Market
description: Slimed stone slabs under a leaking roof where the morning catch is gutted, sold and argued over. Gulls scream from the rafters. The floor is a slurry of scales and guts, and the smell gets into your clothes and stays. The docks are west, the harbour office north, and a ladder climbs to the net loft.

features.name: the gutting slabs
features.look: Long stone slabs crusted with scales. Under them, a gutter full of offal and whatever the fishwives dropped.

search.text: You rake through the gutter under the slabs.

actions.smell: Fish. Old fish. The ghost of fish. It will be on you for a week.

features.name: the gulls
features.look: Fat, mean gulls in the rafters, waiting for anyone to drop anything.

actions.kick: You swing at a gull. It doesn't even move. Another one gets you from behind.
actions.touch: A gull lets you get close, then takes a piece of your sleeve.

title: The Harbourmaster's Office
description: A tarred wooden room over the water, full of charts, tide tables and confiscated goods nobody ever came back for. The harbourmaster is out, as always. A sign on the desk says BRIBES TUESDAYS. The fish market is south.

features.name: the confiscated goods
features.look: Crates, bales and barrels with seizure tags. The tags are old. The seals are broken. Someone has been helping themselves.

actions.search: Tags signed by the harbourmaster, all dated Tuesdays. Every crate is lighter than its tag says.
actions.take: You lift a bale. Under it, a second sign: THIS MEANS YOU. You put it back.

features.name: the tide tables
features.look: Columns of tide times, inked and reinked. Some boats are marked with a little hook.

actions.read: High water, low water, and beside certain dates, small hooks. Always at night.
actions.take: Too big to carry, too dull to steal.

title: The Net Loft
description: A long dim attic over the fish market, hung with drying nets and smelling of tar and salt. Floats and oars are stacked in the corners. At the far end, behind a hanging net, the plank wall looks newer than the rest. A ladder leads down.

features.name: the drying nets
features.look: Heavy fishing nets hung from the beams to dry. One hangs lower than the others, right against the west wall.

open.text: You pull the low net aside. Behind it the planks of the west wall don't quite meet, and there's a latch on this side. You could go west.
open.room: pulls a net aside and looks at the west wall for a long moment.

actions.search: Tangled in the nets: fish scales, a gull feather, and a little brass hook, the kind you'd wear as a sign.

features.name: the floats and oars
features.look: Cork floats, cracked oars and a stack of lobster pots. Nothing worth stealing, which is why nobody guards it.

search.text: You go through the junk in the corners.

actions.kick: A float rolls away across the boards and drops through a hole into the fish market. Someone below swears.

title: Hook's Back Room
description: A windowless room behind the net loft, warm, dry and lamplit, which in Gallowmere means money. Shelves hold things that were somebody else's yesterday. A ledger lies open on a table next to a scale, a knife and a plate of very good cheese. The way out is east.

features.name: the shelves of goods
features.look: Candlesticks, a church plate, three wedding rings, a good cloak, a lute with all its strings. All very clean. No questions asked or answered.

actions.take: Hook doesn't even look up. "Buy it, or keep your fingers."
actions.search: Price tags in tiny neat writing, and on every one, a little drawing of a hook.

features.name: Hook's ledger
features.look: An open ledger, the twin of the one in the Rat's back room. The same neat columns. The same little hooks.

actions.read: Names you know. The Drowned Rat, everything. The harbourmaster, Tuesdays. The captain of the watch, a lot. And a fresh line, ink still wet, with space left for a name.
actions.take: Hook's knife is suddenly on the ledger, between your hand and the page. "No."

title: The Hulk
description: An old ship beached on the mud south of the docks, her back broken and her ribs open to the sky. Children dare each other to go in. Scavengers don't need daring. The tide comes up to her keel twice a day. The docks are north.

features.name: the ship's ribs
features.look: Blackened timbers curving up out of the mud. Barnacles, weed, and caught in between, everything the river ever lost.

search.text: You climb into the wreck and sift the mud between her ribs.

actions.climb: You climb up the ribs to what's left of the deck. The whole wreck groans. You climb back down faster.

features.name: the figurehead
features.look: A carved woman at the bow, face worn smooth by the river, one hand raised as if to wave or warn.

actions.touch: Smooth, wet wood. Someone has tied a ribbon round her wrist. It's new.
actions.read: Faded paint on her chest: the ship's name. THE PATIENCE.

title: The Grate Tunnel
description: Past the bent bars the sewer runs into the dark, a brick tunnel just high enough to walk stooped. Foul water flows ankle deep down the middle. Scratching echoes from somewhere ahead. Light comes from the grate above and nowhere else. The overflow is west.

features.name: the foul water
features.look: Black water carrying the whole town's business down to the river. Things float in it. You don't look closely.

actions.search: You feel along the bottom. Something soft. Something hard. Something that moves. You stop.
actions.smell: Your eyes water. Your stomach tries to leave without you.

features.name: the scratch marks
features.look: Deep scratch marks on the bricks, in sets of four, at about knee height. Fresh.

actions.touch: The grooves are deep enough to fit your fingertips. Whatever made them has claws and patience.
actions.read: Not words. Not quite. But they go somewhere, and they all point west.

title: The Overflow
description: A round brick chamber where three tunnels meet and the water pools before it drains to the river. Bones lie on a ledge, small ones, picked clean. The scratching is louder here. North, a heavy iron door is set into the brick. The tunnel back is east.

features.name: the bone ledge
features.look: A dry ledge above the waterline, heaped with small bones and scraps of cloth. A nest, of sorts.

actions.search: Cat bones. Dog bones. A shoe with no foot in it. You decide you've seen enough nests.
actions.take: Something squeals from inside the pile. You don't take anything.

features.name: the drain
features.look: A grated drain swallows the pooled water with a long sucking sound.

actions.listen: Under the gurgle, a rhythm. Knock, knock, knock. Slow. Patient. North.
actions.push: You lean on the drain grating. It doesn't move. Something on the other side does.

title: Before the Iron Door
description: The tunnel ends at an iron door set deep in old stone, older than the sewers around it. It is chained, padlocked and painted with a warning in red: DO NOT. From the other side comes a slow knocking that stops when you get close. The overflow is south.

features.name: the iron door
features.look: Riveted iron, black with age, held shut with a chain as thick as your wrist and a padlock the size of your fist.

actions.open: Chained and padlocked. Whoever sealed this meant it. Not yet.
actions.push: You push. The door doesn't move. On the other side, something pushes back.

knock.text: You knock twice. The knocking on the other side stops. Then, slowly, it knocks twice back.

actions.listen: Silence. Then, very close to the iron: breathing.

features.name: the red warning
features.look: DO NOT, in red paint, the letters run and dried. Under it, scratched small: we tried.

actions.read: DO NOT. And smaller, scratched: we tried. And smaller still, almost gone: it remembers.
actions.touch: The paint is old and flaking. It comes away red on your fingers like it was never quite dry.
